title: A flaw was found in cpio. A local user can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by triggering a stack-based buffer overflow…
description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in cpio when creating archives in tar or ustar formats. This occurs if files owned by users or groups have names longer than 32 characters, leading to an unbounded copy into fixed-size memory and causing the application to crash. The flaw results in a Denial of Service (DoS) condition.
